neighbours.label: words that say a task or situation is made harder or obstructed (complicated, difficult, hindered, disturbed, separated), with or without a following 'by'; neutral passives with 'by' stay silent
fire: Moving the piano upstairs was made far more complicated by the narrow staircase.
The negotiations were hindered by a long dispute over fishing rights.
Their journey home became difficult once the snow started to fall.
The calm of the morning was briefly disturbed by a barking dog.
The investigation was complicated further by missing phone records.
Progress on the bridge was slowed and obstructed by repeated floods.
Finding a doctor in the village is difficult for many older residents.
The repairs were hampered by a shortage of spare parts.
quiet: Moving the piano upstairs was done by two strong neighbours.
The negotiations were led by a senior diplomat from Norway.
Their journey home was paid for by the company.
The calm of the morning was lovely after a noisy week.
The investigation was carried out by a team of local officers.
Progress on the bridge was reported by the city newspaper.
Finding a doctor in the village is something most residents do online.
The repairs were finished by a carpenter from the next town.

predictions: fire 0.4-0.8 on complicated/difficult/hindered-type words; neutral passive participles ('written by', 'baked by') and pleasant predicates below 0.08
notes: Card: ' complicated' x4, ' complex', ' separated', ' hindered', 'disturbed' before 'by' ('made more complex by the height', 'complicated by the perplexing legal nature'). Probe shows 'by' is not needed: 'made more complicated by' 0.703, 'more complicated because' 0.609, 'was difficult in the fog' 0.627, 'only disturbed by' 0.555, 'separated by a river' 0.529, 'hindered by' 0.436; 'written by a young author' 0.015, 'baked by my grandmother' 0.020, 'simply beautiful' 0.058.
